mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.master_venue (id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{address}, #{city}, #{locationLat}, #{locationLng}, #{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{confidence}, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.master_venue SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, city = #{city}, location_lat = #{locationLat}, location_lng = #{locationLng}, metadata = #{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.JsonTypeHandler}, confidence = #{confidence}, source = #{source}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WITH upserted_external AS ( INSERT INTO public.master_venue_external (id, master_venue_id, provider, provider_external_id, raw_payload, confidence, crawled_at) VALUES (#{external.id}, #{venue.id}, #{external.provider}, #{external.providerExternalId}, #{external.rawPayload, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{external.confidence}, #{external.crawledAt}) ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_external_id) DO UPDATE SET raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, crawled_at = EXCLUDED.crawled_at RETURNING master_venue_id ) INSERT INTO public.master_venue (id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source) SELECT upserted_external.master_venue_id, #{venue.name}, #{venue.address}, #{venue.city}, #{venue.locationLat}, #{venue.locationLng}, #{venue.metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.foundation.mybatis.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{venue.confidence}, #{venue.source} FROM upserted_external ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, address = EXCLUDED.address, city = EXCLUDED.city, location_lat = EXCLUDED.location_lat, location_lng = EXCLUDED.location_lng, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, source = EXCLUDED.source, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, created_at, updated_at
SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, created_at, updated_at FROM public.master_venue WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, created_at, updated_at FROM public.master_venue ORDER BY name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, created_at, updated_at FROM public.master_venue WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}) ORDER BY name

where.if: AND (LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(address) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) OR LOWER(city) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')))
